_comment_: Tracera personal dogfooding config. Edit apiBase to point at your running Tracera rich gateway (default: loopback :18000). See bin/tracera help text (tracera <subcommand> --help) for command usage; in-repo bin/ has the canonical CLI source.
_auth_: Optional. If your server requires auth, set the bearer token here. NEVER commit a real token to source control — this file lives at ~/.tracera/config.json (outside any repo).
